Facts: Liu sold counterfeit (fake) Chinese herbal decoction pieces (中药饮片) under false company name, without drug production qualification. That's production and sale of counterfeit (fake) drugs => crime of producing and selling counterfeit drugs (假药). The law: 《刑法》第二百一十七条 生产、销售假药罪. Also illegal drug business? Actually it's not a controlled substance, but it's a drug. So charge: 生产、销售假药罪.

Second: illegal drug business (illegal drug operation) but more precisely: illegal drug (药品) business without license: "非法经营药品罪" (illegal drug/medicine business). Under Criminal Law article 141? Actually article 141 is about illegal business of medical devices? The text says "违反国家规定，未经许可经营药品，情节特别严重，行为已构成××". So that is "非法经营药品罪". So we have two charges: 生产、销售假药罪;非法经营药品罪.
